csv_project_name: Professional Services for Lee Street Multi-use trail Imprs
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Atlanta, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a Consultant to provide professional services from a qualified consultant ( Consultant ) to provide design and engineering services for the Lee Street Trail. The Lee Street Trail is a proposed 2.75-mile multi-use trail connecting the West End MARTA Station with the Lakewood Fort McPherson MARTA Station. The Lee Street Trail has been identified in City planning efforts since the early 1990s and supports connetivity between MARTA Stations, the Atlanta BeltLine, and future regional trail networks. The proposed trail extends approximately 2.75 miles along the east side of Lee Street (U.S. Highway 29), from Ralph David Abernathy Boulevard to the Lakewood-Fort McPherson MARTA Station. The design includes roadway reconfiguration, an 8 to 12-foot multi-use trail, landscaped buffers, barriers where needed, pedestrian lighting, intersection improvements, a HAWK signal, and wayfinding signage.
